name: History Scholar Study
body:
Associated Skill Knowledge (history) (Int)

Basic Study Ability
Lessons of the Past (Ex)

By spending one hour studying your history books each morning, you can gain the benefit of any one feat you do not already possess. You use your ranks in Knowledge (history) to meet any character level requirements for this feat, and must otherwise meet all of the chosen feat’s prerequisites. If the feat can be used a limited number of times per day (such as Stunning Fist), you must also expend 1 point of inspiration each time you use the feat. You may not use this feat to meet any other prerequisites, and you lose use of the feat once you complete another night’s rest.

Associated Technique
Learning Technique (Ex)

If the opponent you have studied with this technique has dealt damage to you within the past round, you gain a +1 dodge bonus to your AC against that opponent. This dodge bonus increases by 1 at 4th level and every 4 levels thereafter, to a maximum of +6 at 20th level.

Advanced Study Abilities
Complementary Scholarship (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Lessons of the Past study ability, scholar level 2nd.

You have learned how to apply your understanding of history to other fields. You can substitute ranks in Knowledge (history) for ranks in another skill in which you have fewer ranks on a two-for-one basis. (Note, however, that these “ranks” cannot be used to meet any prerequisites.) For example, if you have 10 ranks in Knowledge (history), you can attempt an Acrobatics check as if you have 5 ranks in that skill. Ability bonuses, proficiency, and other modifiers are applied as usual for each individual skill; you do not use the bonuses that you have for Knowledge (history) for these skills.

Learn from Mistakes (Ex)

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (history) 5 ranks, Lessons of the Past study ability, scholar level 5th.

You gain Strong Comeback as a bonus feat. Once per day, you can reroll any one ability check, skill check, or saving throw by expending 2 points of inspiration (applying your Strong Comeback bonus to this roll as usual). You also gain Measure Foe as a bonus feat, but you can choose to use a Knowledge (history) check instead of a Sense Motive check when using this feat.

You do not need to meet the usual prerequisites for either of these feats.

Object Reading (Su)

Prerequisite(s): Lessons of the Past study ability, Psychic Sensitivity or the ability to cast psychic spells, scholar level 3rd.

You gain the object reading ability, as the occultist class feature, except that you make a Knowledge (history) skill check instead of an Appraise check.

Unchanging (Su)

Prerequisite(s): Knowledge (history) 6 ranks, Lessons of the Past study ability, scholar level 6th.

You can influence the timestream and bypass effects that could invalidate your efforts. As an immediate action, you can expend 1 point of inspiration to negate a power, spell, or effect that forces you to reroll any one attack roll, damage roll, or saving throw. Alternately, you can spend a point of inspiration as an immediate action to avoid a single roll for a condition or effect that gives you a random chance for one attack to miss (such as concealment, mirror image, blur, or blink).
